title: Blog Post Asks Whether a Linear Program Can Do Weight-Space Model Editing
summary: A post on nathan.rs poses the question of whether linear programming can be used for weight-space programming — editing a neural network&\#x27;s weights directly to change its behavior — and the Hacker News thread took up how such a method would actually be applied. The framing is exploratory: the supplied material describes an examination of LP as a weight-editing tool and includes no benchmark results, released code, or measured comparison against existing editing methods, so the post&\#x27;s conclusions could not be checked here. Commenters extended the idea in several directions, including weight-space distillation, sparse weight edits, and enforcing the constraints during training rather than after it.
